result.instructions: Tools for Trestle, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is the phone number +44 20 7946 0958 valid, and is it a mobile or a landline?"; "Check whether this lead's number (206) 973-5100 is likely connected: give me the activity score."; "Does this US number belong to a known TCPA litigator before we call it?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Trestle data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run trestle_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run trestle_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run trestle_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. trestle_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: trestle_validate_phone
tools.title: Validate a phone number
tools.description: Check a phone number with Trestle Phone Validation. Returns whether it is valid, its country and carrier, its line type (Mobile, Landline, FixedVOIP, NonFixedVOIP, TollFree and so on), whether it is prepaid, and a 0-100 activity score (70 or above: likely connected; 30 or below: likely disconnected or unanswered). Does not return the owner's name. Use only for identity or lead verification, or caller routing. Never use the result for credit, insurance, employment, housing or benefits decisions (FCRA), or for marketing. Trestle Phone Validation API: GET /3.0/phone_intel.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 (+12069735100) or local format (2069735100). Pair a local number with country_hint.

country_hint.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code of a local-format number, for example US.

tools.name: trestle_check_tcpa_litigator
tools.title: Check a US number for TCPA litigator risk
tools.description: Validate a US phone number and run Trestle's TCPA litigator check. Returns add_ons.litigator_checks['phone.is_litigator_risk']: true when the subscriber is a known TCPA litigator, null when the check could not finish. US numbers only. The check is a paid add-on and works only when it is enabled on the API key; otherwise add_ons is missing from the reply. Use it to verify leads before you call or text them. Use only for identity or lead verification, or caller routing. Never use the result for credit, insurance, employment, housing or benefits decisions (FCRA), or for marketing. Trestle Phone Validation API: GET /3.0/phone_intel with add_ons=litigator_checks.
